name: Postiz (social media scheduling SaaS)
description: Postiz is a social media scheduling & management SaaS at $159k MRR (Nevo David). Advice: don't build in public to get customers the traditional way — talk about your product. Recurring revenue SaaS in the creator/marketing tool space.

name: SuperX (social tool, $23k MRR)
description: Solo founder's social-media tool hit $1k MRR on day one, now $23K MRR with ~650 paying customers at $39/mo, growing 20-25% MoM. Launched July 2025, after five failed products. Lesson: 'content is the distribution'. Run while traveling.

name: SenjaHQ (testimonial SaaS, $76k MRR)
description: Testimonial collection & social proof SaaS. August #buildinpublic report: hit $76,000 MRR (net MRR grew $2k vs $4k goal). B2B testimonial widget for websites.

name: SecureVibing (app security scanner, $6.7k MRR)
description: Portfolio of profitable dev-tool products; flagship SecureVibing.com auto-scans web apps/SaaS for exposed API keys, public databases, missing RLS constraints. Reached $6,772 MRR by week 21, with just $20/day Meta ads. First $100 MRR came from a Hacker News launch.

name: Launching-apps portfolio ($3.3k MRR)
description: Indie hacker launched countless small apps until one gained momentum: $3.3k MRR, 130+ paying customers, $20k gross revenue. Spotted a viral Reddit thread and immediately productized the demand (customer-first validation).

name: Outbid.lol (排名拍卖站, 48h营收$10万)
description: 排名拍卖网站，域名outbid.lol，直击本质。发布48小时内营收10万美元(约$100K)，2美元域名成本。典型独立开发者side project：build in public + 社媒传播 + 短期热点流量快速变现，原地转导航站，导流原有长期主业项目 + mini广告流量平台 + leaderboard排行榜玩法设计。

name: Chatterleys 工具 (月入1万人民币)
description: 独立开发者做的一个工具，去年3月偶然有一个用户开始人传人，第一个月几百块，去年每月约3000多，今年每月约7000多，前几个月四五千，最近几个月每月约1万块人民币(约$1,400/月)。靠口碑自然增长，无投放。

name: 多平台内容工具 (月流水4700元)
description: 独立开发一年半的一个'丑工具'，注册用户3800+，付费转化率6%(约228付费用户)，月流水4000-5000元(约$660/月)。目标用户从'所有内容创作者'收窄到'每天发多平台内容的自媒体运营'，定价从订阅改按次付费，转化率反升。获客靠小红书+即刻自然流量。教训：砍到只做3个平台留存涨一倍。

name: 极简时钟 (MRR $699)
description: vulgur 的极简时钟App，2025年MRR最高$699(仅订阅收入)，刨去应用商店分成后近2万元人民币。工具类App出海案例，作者坦承'MRR有点低'。健康类/效率类App均停留在demo阶段。

name: テック・ブック・ランク (技术书排名站, 3周10万日元)
description: 技术书籍排名网站，开站3周即获10万日元(约$670)广告收益。个人开发+广告变现的典型：抓取/聚合技术书销量数据做排行榜，靠SEO自然流量起量。作者主张'不要只做自己想要的东西，要判断世人想要什么'。
